feeds.title: FMLA Insights
feeds.description: The FMLA Insights blog provides analysis on the Family Medical Leave Act for employers. Authored by Jeff Nowak, a recognized leader on FMLA and ADA issues. Jeff Nowak is a shareholder at Littler Mendelson P.C., the world's largest employment and labor law practice representing management. Jeff has decades of experience advising and litigating on behalf of employers on a wide range of complex employment law matters.

feeds.title: Understanding the ADA Blog » FMLA
feeds.description: William Goren is one of the country's foremost authorities on the American with Disabilities Act (ADA) and the Rehabilitation Act of 1973. Since 1990, he has been advising on ADA compliance as both an attorney and professor - of which during his time as a full-time academic at various institutions in Chicago, he won numerous teaching awards and achieved tenure. The FMLA section is dedicated to Family and Medical Leave Act providing latest news and updates, case stories and more!
